map.需要转义成 \\|，否则会被当作列分隔符破坏整行结构，这是 Markdown 表:
Escape it as \|, otherwise it is read as a column separator and breaks the whole row — the most common pitfall with Markdown tables. Also note that line breaks inside a cell cannot be expressed directly in standard Markdown; people usually switch to the
tag (though some platforms escape HTML) or split the content into multiple records.
map.行数取输入值并保证在 1 到 50 之间（非法时取 1），列数取输入值并保证在: The row count is taken from the input and clamped to 1–50 (1 when invalid), and the column count to 1–20 (1 when invalid). Header and body seeds are both split on commas, each item trimmed, leading empty items removed, then truncated to the column count. Cells are filled with seed values in order; when none remain, "C" plus the column index is used as a placeholder, and the content is Markdown-escaped. The separator row is generated according to alignment: centered has colons on both sides, right-aligned has a trailing colon, and the rest have a leading colon; each column marker is joined with a space-pipe-space. Each body row appends the row index after the seed values, is wrapped in pipes, and its cells are joined with space-pipe-space. Finally the header row, separator row, and body rows are concatenated in order
